purpose: Group differently worded user reports by technical evidence and diagnostic state.
principles: Never bucket only by user wording
Exact technical codes outrank keyword similarity
A bucket is a diagnostic class, not proof of root cause
Keep incompatible evidence in separate buckets
Successful fixes may raise confidence but do not rewrite historical evidence

fallback.rule: If evidence is insufficient, collect exactly one highest-information missing signal before asking another broad question.
fallback.never: restart symptom classification after user says not helped while a case is active
